figures.finding: The Slovak Audiovisual Fund's audiovisual industry support is a 33% cash rebate on eligible expenses paid in Slovakia, with minimum eligible spend of EUR 300,000 for a fiction TV series, EUR 100,000 for a feature film or documentary series and EUR 50,000 for a documentary or animation, reached within three years of registration; in 2022 it paid more than EUR 7.5 million and registered 92 projects.

value.name: Audiovizuálny fond – podpora audiovizuálneho priemyslu (cash rebate)
value.recipient: person or entity registered in Slovakia

figures.applies: Slovakia, as described by the Slovak Film Institute (2022 data).

sources.said: based on 33% cash rebate the Fund supported in 2022 film projects by total amount of more than 7.5 mil. €. Minimum limit of eligible expenses for cash rebate scheme is 300 000 € (feature TV series), 100 000 € (feature films, documentary series) or 50 000 € (documentary film, animation film or series) over a period of 3 years after the project registration. Expenses should be paid for production of film project in Slovakia.

In 2022, the Slovak Audiovisual Fund registered 92 projects of audiovisual industry support and 521 applications for audiovisual culture support, of which 345 (66 %) were supported by the total amount of 10.6 mil. €.

figures.finding: The Fund's selective support for audiovisual culture funded 44 of 105 fiction-film applications in 2022 (EUR 4.94 million of EUR 16.4 million requested), 40 of 94 documentaries and 18 of 29 animated films; in 2026 its production grants totalled EUR 2.27 million, EUR 1.37 million of it for feature films and fiction series.

sources.said: Fiction films 105 16 366 246 € 44 4 941 000 € Documentary films 94 3 620 652 € 40 938 000 € Animated films 29 1 567 083 € 18 806 800 € Student films 24 278 322 € 18 56 000 € Minority co-productions 33 2 504 858 € 15 1 040 000 €

The Slovak Audiovisual Fund has distributed 2,271,440 m EUR through 2026 as production grants for feature films, medium and long documentaries, animated films, TV series, and minority coproductions. The funding was distributed for feature film and fiction TV series production (1.37 m EUR), documentary and TV series documentary production (325,000 EUR), animated film production (216,440 EUR)
Recipient of financing from the Fund shall be individual or legal entity registered in the Slovak Republic.

figures.finding: Slovakia's cash rebate is 33% of eligible spend paid from 1 January 2020 (20% before), by Act 304/2019 amending the Audiovisual Fund Act; the film commission puts the minimum Slovak spend at €100,000 for a feature, €50,000 for a documentary or animation and €300,000 for a series of up to 26 episodes, over 3 years from registration (fee €1,000).
